analogy.rationale: Diuretics act on renal ion transporters and receptors that are largely absent from these cancer cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; thiazide diuretics share the closest transport mechanism, while carbonic anhydrase and mineralocorticoid-related classes are the nearest renal-pathway neighbors.
